verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 re-entry is on Friday, April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'post-splashdown news conference Friday night'; R4: 'Friday'; R2: 'April 10, 2026'; R5: 'Friday'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm the date April 10, 2026, and specify it as Friday.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 re-entry is around 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PT).
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'splashdown occurred at 8:07 p.m. ET'; R2: 'Splashdown is targeted for 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT)'; R4: 'splash down... around 5:07 p.m.'; reentry earlier at ~7:53 p.m. ET / 4:53 p.m. PT
verifications.reasoning: Sources distinguish reentry/entry interface (~7:53 ET) from splashdown (8:07 ET); claim misattributes splashdown time to reentry.
